ddl.name: deleted_ranges_shape_check
ddl.value: ("scope" = 'all' and "track_run_id" is null and "sample_start" is null and "sample_end" is null) or ("scope" = 'track_run' and "track_run_id" is not null and "sample_start" is not null and "sample_end" is not null and "sample_start" >= 0 and "sample_end" > "sample_start")

ddl.name: calls_end_check
ddl.value: ("ended_wall_ms" is null and "ended_continuous_us" is null and "end_reason" is null) or ("ended_wall_ms" is not null and "ended_continuous_us" is not null and "end_reason" is not null and "ended_continuous_us" >= "started_continuous_us")

ddl.name: chunks_archive_check
ddl.value: ("archive_rel_path" is null) = ("archive_byte_offset" is null) and ("archive_byte_offset" is null or "archive_byte_offset" >= 0)

ddl.name: listens_end_check
ddl.value: ("ended_wall_ms" is null and "ended_continuous_us" is null and "end_reason" is null) or ("ended_wall_ms" is not null and "ended_continuous_us" is not null and "end_reason" is not null and "ended_continuous_us" >= "started_continuous_us")

ddl.name: speech_regions_end_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'open' and "sample_end" is null) or ("state" = 'closed' and "sample_end" is not null and "wall_end_ms" is not null and "sample_end" > "sample_start")

ddl.name: track_runs_end_check
ddl.value: ("state" = 'open' and "ended_wall_ms" is null) or ("state" <> 'open' and "ended_wall_ms" is not null)

ddl.name: context_items_span_check
ddl.value: ("span_start" is null and "span_end" is null) or ("span_start" is not null and "span_end" > "span_start")

ddl.name: context_items_file_check
ddl.value: ("kind" in ('image', 'file')) = ("file_sha256" is not null and "file_bytes" is not null and "media_type" is not null)

ddl.name: identity_rules_target_check
ddl.value:
(case "scope"
        when 'global' then "app_id" is null and "device_id" is null and "episode_id" is null
        when 'app' then "app_id" is not null and "device_id" is null and "episode_id" is null
        when 'device' then "device_id" is not null and "app_id" is null and "episode_id" is null
        when 'episode' then "episode_id" is not null and "app_id" is null and "device_id" is null
        else 0 end)
